section_summary.extract_value: Study 2 describes a validation study of the SBAS-2 (State Body Appreciation Scale-2) designed to detect momentary changes in body appreciation. Participants responded to the SBAS-2 after imagining scenarios that manipulated the extent to which important others (family, friends, romantic partners, or media) communicated acceptance of the participant's body. This methodology was based on previous research showing that perceived acceptance from important others is a strong predictor of body appreciation.
